items.title: South Korea's Samsung SDI to buy out GM's stake in battery joint venture
items.summary: Aug 11 () - South Korean battery maker Samsung SDI said on Tuesday it will end its joint venture agreement with General Motors in ‌Indiana and acquire the U.99% stake, citing weaker-than-expected electric ‌vehicle demand.
